main.API-002: | `API-002` | Sentry Web API and Terraform compatibility | target | partial | `tests/sentry-cli/field-refusals.mjs` fieldRefusalFlow (unsupported top-level fields on both release-create aliases, update and finalization, and deployment creation; populated-state nonmutation, safe D-1 refusal facts, named endpoint and refs errors, read-only and revoked grants, project scope); `tests/sentry-cli/denials.mjs` authorityFlow and denialFlow (existing deploy-key authority); `tests/sentry-cli-compat.mjs` with releaseFlow, pluginFlow, chunkFlow and durableFlow (unmodified CLI and plugins, valid commands, retries, inert restore and erasure) | Qualified only the currently implemented SRC-003 deploy-key doors. Acceptance 1 and 2 remain unproved: complete organization, team, member, project, client-key, issue, event, release and alert Web API compatibility, Sentry search and cursor Link pagination, organization and personal token mapping to TEAM-001 roles, and the unmodified Terraform plan, apply, import and unchanged re-plan journey. Unsupported nested fields and field validation outside the selected top-level release-create, release-update and deployment-create JSON bodies remain unproved. Existing SRC-003 capabilities and gaps remain, including SRC-002 connected-provider accounts, SDK-002 native debug-file and device qualification, and SRC-004 capacity with BILL-001 pricing dependencies. |
